sentences.text: Heyuannia was a small dinosaur estimated to be 1.5 meters long and weighing twenty kilograms. It possessed a short, toothless skull with a steep snout and very short arms with reduced digits.
Thousands of eggs were uncovered at the discovery site, suggesting a partially open nest and increased parental care.

Heyuannia was the first oviraptorid dinosaur discovered in China. The holotype of Heyuannia huangi was found in the Dalangshan Formation near Huangsha, Guangdong. Fossils attributed to Heyuannia include one specimen that may contain reproductive organs. Heyuannia yanshini was first described as the genus Ingenia yanshini by Rinchen Barsbold in 1981.
Heyuannia was classified within the family Oviraptoridae by Lü in 2002. The exact subfamily placement of Heyuannia is uncertain, with later analyses placing it in either Oviraptorinae or Ingeniinae.
